name: In Ningyo Hime
source:
Tina is a mermaid who wants to become human. In order to become human, she must experience something that fish do not have, namely THAT. Tina, who was a pure mermaid, has her unknown erogenous zones attacked by a lustful beast, and as she writhes in agony, she transforms into a seductive woman.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/242105/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
蒂娜是一条想成为人类的美人鱼。为了成为人类，她必须经历鱼所没有的东西，即“那”。蒂娜原本是一条纯洁的美人鱼，但她未知的性感区遭到了淫欲野兽的攻击，她痛苦地翻滚，摇身一变，变成了一个妖媚的女人。
